name: drunkyard
description: Drunk Yard — anonymous video rooms for 2–6 people with games and drink gifting

scripts.setup: npm --prefix Server install && npm --prefix Client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix Client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix Client run build && npm --prefix Server ci --include=dev && npm --prefix Server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix Server run typecheck && npm --prefix Client run typecheck
